meta.description: Full session startup for worktree agents — shells to session-pickup --from fresh (sync master + preflight), reports state (handoff mode, dispatch drift, monitor health), relaunches dead monitors, hands back next-action.

copy.tagline: 自动恢复工作树代理的会话并监控运行状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要重启开发代理并希望自动完成同步和监控恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Resume worktree agent sessions with full startup automation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically restart agent sessions and monitor their health.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 会自动同步主分支、进行预检、报告当前状态（交接模式、调度累积、监控健康），重新启动已停止的监控器，并给出下一步操作。
howto.when: 当 Claude 在工作树中开始新会话、长时间暂停后恢复、或需要完全中间同步时触发。不要用于紧凑恢复或会话结束。

say.text: 恢复会话并重新启动监控器
say.note: 报告 handoff 和 dispatch 状态

say.text: 同步主分支并检查状态

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude automatically syncs the master branch, runs preflight checks, reports state (handoff mode, dispatch drift, monitor health), relaunches dead monitors, and hands back the next action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude starts a new session in a worktree, resumes after a long pause, or needs a full mid-session resync. Not for compact resume or session end.
